widgets_values:
Motion transfer task.

reference_image_0 is the only source of appearance and environment. reference_video_0 is the only source of motion, expression and camera. Nothing else from reference_video_0 may be used.

1. MOTION, POSE, EXPRESSION AND MOUTH: The person from reference_image_0 fully replicates the person in reference_video_0: every body movement, pose, gesture, hand position, head movement, facial expression, eye direction, mouth movement and lip shape, with the same order, speed and timing. Describe this second by second with exact timestamps, exactly as it happens in reference_video_0. Only describe what actually happens. Do not smooth, slow down, merge, skip, exaggerate or invent anything, and do not copy the pose from reference_image_0. If the person in reference_image_0 holds an object that conflicts with the hand movements, leave the object out and follow the video's hand movements.

2. APPEARANCE AND ENVIRONMENT LOCK: Describe the person and the environment strictly from reference_image_0, and state that they stay identical in every second of the video.
- Hairstyle (most important): exact hair length, hair color, parting, whether it is tied up, in a ponytail, a bun, braided or worn loose, where it ends, its texture, and any bangs. The hair never becomes longer, shorter, looser or a different style at any moment.
- Face and makeup: face shape, eyes, eyebrows, lips, skin tone and makeup style.
- Clothing (complete, item by item, from top to bottom): list every visible garment, including outerwear, tops, inner layers, bottoms, dresses, socks or stockings, and shoes. For each item describe its color, pattern or print, material and texture, cut and fit, length, neckline, collar, sleeves, buttons, zippers, pockets, belts, trims, logos or emblems, and how it is worn (open, closed, tucked in, rolled up). Leave nothing out.
- Accessories (complete, item by item): list every visible accessory, including hair accessories, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, rings, watches, glasses, hats, scarves, ties, bags and straps. For each item describe its color, material, shape, size and exact position on the body. Do not add any accessory that is not in reference_image_0, and do not remove any that is.
- Environment: the scene, background, objects, lighting and color tone of reference_image_0, present from the very first frame and unchanged for the whole video.
Never describe the person in reference_video_0 in any way: no face, hairstyle, hair length, hair color, hair accessories, makeup, clothing, jewelry, props or body shape. Never describe the background, scene, lighting or color tone of reference_video_0.

3. CAMERA AND CUTS: Fully replicate the camera work of reference_video_0: shot size, framing, angle, camera movement and its speed, and every cut or shot change at the exact same time. Describe each shot separately as [Shot 1], [Shot 2] and so on, with its timestamps. Every shot keeps the environment of reference_image_0.

4. NO SKELETON OR DEPTH RESIDUE: Any skeleton lines, joint dots, face dots, depth maps, gray silhouettes or black backgrounds are only invisible guides. Never describe or draw them. The final video shows only a real person with clean skin and clean clothing in the environment of reference_image_0. End your output prompt with this sentence: "The image is clean, with no lines, dots, skeleton marks or depth shading on the person or the background."

5. NO SUBTITLES: Ignore any on-screen text, captions or subtitles in reference_video_0. Do not describe, copy or recreate them. The generated video must have no subtitles, captions or on-screen text of any kind.

Do not describe or generate any background music. Only keep natural ambient sounds and clothing rustle. Write any spoken lines exactly as heard, in their original language.

<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>: pale porcelain skin, large dark eyes, very long straight white hair with two ring-shaped buns on top of her head, a white crop top, a sheer white hooded capelet with wide draped sleeves and silver embroidery, a short white skirt with an ornate silver chain belt, and white lace-up boots. Her face, hair and outfit come only from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 1> performs the body movement, facial expressions and mouth movements of the woman in <Video 1>. Only the motion, expressions and mouth shapes are taken from <Video 1>; her identity, face, hair and clothing are never taken from <Video 1>.

The target video is in a bright, high-key, ethereal winter fantasy style, with strong backlight from the upper left, a soft rim glow on her white hair and sheer sleeves, and a light lens flare. The scene is a snow-covered field in front of a hillside of bare and coniferous trees under a clear sky.
[Shot 1] A fixed medium shot, waist-up. <Subject 1> walks in from the right edge of the frame with her body angled to the front-left, then turns her head to the camera and smiles, copying the head turn and smile timing of <Video 1>. Her left arm swings loosely and her right arm lifts slightly.
[Shot 1 continues, 1s-2s] She makes one fast clockwise full spin on the spot exactly as in <Video 1>; her long white hair, wide sleeves and translucent cape swirl outward, and fine snow dust lifts in the air.
[Shot 1 continues, 2s-3s] She faces the camera again with eyes gently closed and a soft smile, head tilted slightly to the left, both hands rising toward her waist, matching <Video 1>.
[Shot 1 continues, 3s-5s] She opens her eyes, looks up at the camera, puts both hands on her hips with elbows out, leans slightly forward and sways left and right to the beat, her head bobbing lightly and her smile following the expressions of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1 continues, 5s-6s] Her right hand drops out of frame while her left hand stays on her hip; she turns her head to one side, glances away and then looks back at the camera, as in <Video 1>.
[Shot 1 continues, 6s-8s] Her right hand returns to her hip; she smiles at the camera and keeps swaying to the beat until the end.
Camera: fixed medium shot, no camera movement, her upper body stays centered in the frame.
Audio: light wind and soft snow sounds with an upbeat rhythmic electronic beat; she does not speak.
Negative: no scythe / no extra people / no text overlays / no camera shake / no dissolve transitions

properties.text:
1-动作迁移尽量去做首帧数匹配
2-这套工作流测试下来算是比较快速，运行流畅的，如果采用单采样去做，非常的慢
3-目前的动作迁移是纯做动作迁移的，会保留原参考图像的背景的，口型跟表情可以得到同步迁移，也会不稳定的哈，需要抽卡的
4-提示词方面本地配置不太好的，尽量用agent去写提示词，关乎最终生成的效果
5-在做测试的过程中，突然发现，没必要去做动作迁移的，我直接做人物替换流就可以了~所以这个流只是做个分享，想要玩的可以体验一下，后续还是会优化人物替换单人及多人，包括换背景！
